decisions.reason: The aloe vera line builds directly on existing natural skincare know-how and has dedicated website presence, so the firm can interpret results and improve it, making drop unlikely.
The hyaluronic acid serum is close to existing facial care capabilities but less prominently featured, yet related knowledge allows learning from early results, so keep.
The cleansing milk is a simple product within the firm's core competence, so absorptive capacity supports keeping it.
